properties.name: A1043/24 / LCPH
properties.originalText:
HIGH-VOLTAGE POWER LINES AFFECTING OBSTACLE LIMITATION SURFACES.
HIGH VOLTAGE (132KV) POWER LINES EXISTS APPROXIMATELY 4,5 KM NORTH 
EAST OF THRESHOLD RWY 29 OF PAFOS AIRPORT EXTENDING TO THE SOUTH 
EAST. 
THE HEIGHT OF THE UNMARKED AND UNLIGHTED STRUCTURES SUPPORTING THE 
POWER LINES (PYLONS) IS 45M (150FT) AGL. 
PILOTS SHALL EXERCISE CAUTION WHEN FLYING IN THE
AREA ESPECIALLY IN CONDITIONS OF LOW VISIBILITY.
